items.docs: Renders a screenshot, PDF, or video of a URL or HTML and blocks until the asset is ready. Responds 200 OK with a temporary renderUrl and timing metrics. Long-running requests may return 307 Temporary Redirect with a Location header after ~95 seconds.

Accepts the same render options as the sync endpoint and returns immediately with a renderId and statusUrl. The render is processed in the background; results are retrieved by polling the status URL or via a configured webhook_url callback.
